Featuring some of my favorite products from my daily routine .. After washing my face, I use the @pixibeauty glow tonic which is basically a toner but one of the best ones at it. In a few uses you will notice that it gives you an instant glow. It also contains haluronic acid which prevents outbreaks in your face and tones down the existing ones. 
After that, I use the @farsalicare unicorn essence which is oil free and anti oxidants packed, contains vitamin c and also has anti aging properties.
After the serum dries off, I use the @origins ginzing refreshing eye cream to brighten and de puff. It does depuffs your eyes as it claims and the brightening is temporary , however it doesnt reduce@dark circles ( never come across any cream that does - if you have , let me know )

Next, I use the @chanelofficial le lift firming and anti aging cream which is a non - oily non comedoegenic cream base which is super light ( I picked the one for oily skin ) it claims to contain indgredients that work on a molecular level that fights aging and boosts collagen. I love the formula. And It is said that people above 25 can use anti aging creams coz “prevention is better than cure”. I do not use B.B. creams and foundations on a daily basis but I definitely use sunscreen with spf 30+ atleast and is water resistant. @neutrogena is good but it does not contain UVA and UVB protection. I recommend something that gives that too. 
I have used a lot of lip balms but @vaselinebrand Jelly and @burtsbees Balm work the best. All the brands coming up with baby soft lips with tint don’t do anything but dry the lips further in time. Tried and tested.
Last but not the least moisturise and protect your body against the sun and no product works easier than Vaseline moisturiser that provides both in one go. 
So that was my daily beauty regime. Hope this insight turns out useful ! Xx

I've been craving a trip back to California. Maybe it's because of the beauty and awe that surrounds the state or maybe it's because of the incredible experience I created with my children. 
Our family trip to California was one of my favorite vacations. The memories, talks, experiences and dreams created were priceless. It was a dream trip I had on my vision board for years to take my kids by myself as a single mom. 
But what mattered most during that trip was the connection and uninterrupted family time. There was no work, school or sports schedule. Just uninterrupted time to explore and soak in a new place together. I watched my children's face light up and I listened to their dreams. 
Why can't we create moments like that every day? Why can't we soak in the beauty around us in the routine mediocre moments? Listen to our loved ones dreams, create experiences in the day to day activities and fully be present. 
Last night I apologized to my kids for the times they didn't feel like I was really listening and that I wanted them to know that their feelings, dreams and presence was incredibly important and purposeful. Because that's what matters. Authentic life giving connection and experiences are what we should strive for. I would never want to teach my children anything less or go through life questioning their incredible divine purpose. If we approach the people around us with love, purpose and truth we can experience those authentic connections and beyond our wildest dreams experiences. We have only one wild and beautiful life, live it fully. #californiadreaming #purposefulliving #designyourlife

Old and new, all blended in a weird but appealing mix of contrasts. This is what Bucharest is all about!⠀
I used to hate this building. Until I found out its story during a wonderful free walking tour with @walkabout_free_tours!⠀
⠀
The old building was actually headquarters for the State Security during the Communist period, where they tortured people! It was such a place of grief and such a powerful symbol of the regime that Romanians tore it down at the Revolution in 1989.⠀
⠀
A few years ago it was taken over by the Union of Romanian Architects and they built the glass structure to bring the place into the present and try to erase all the painful memories. But still kept part of the old structure as a tribute to all who suffered here.⠀
I now feel a deep respect towards this building. And I'm beginning to like the mix of old and new!

Se fossi un uomo probabilmente non mi chiederei cosa farei se fossi donna.

If I were a man I would be attracted to those women who do not remember being beautiful, those who move their hair naturally and often wear jeans and converse.
If I were a man I probably would not ask myself what I would do if I were a woman.

Es war an der Zeit, das #Münsterland, die Region in der ich groß geworden bin, mal genauer zu erkunden. Und zwar mit dem Rad. 1.000 Kilometer entlang 100 Schlössern, Burgen und Herrenhäusern, unterteilt in vier Kurse: Ost, Nord, Süd und West.

Mein geliebtes Reiserad blieb diesmal zu Hause. Diese Radreise unternahm ich mit einem Leihrad, genauer gesagt einem E-Bike von Bernd vom @canucamp in Münster. Ich war neugierig, wie es ist, knapp zwei Wochen mal mit einem Elektrorad unterwegs zu sein. 
Auch wenn es an diesem Nachmittag noch nicht allzu viel zu sehen gab, jeder Tritt in die Pedale auf der "100 Schlösser Route" fühlt sich nach Freiheit und Sorglosigkeit an. Die Neugier wächst und es das Wetter ist traumhaft. Die gemütlichen Picknickhäuser entlang der Route laden zum Entspannen ein. {Recipe included for bulgur wheat pongal and atte ka halwa}⁣
Last night dinner scenes. Initially, I was planning to make my mom's tiffin sambar with moong dal. But then I realized its been ages since I made the pesaru pappu charu (moong dal stew/gravy) Made it no onion no garlic though. I have the Instant Pot recipe version on the blog. I will link it up in the stories. ⁣
So I have bulgur wheat pongal in the pool of pesaru pappu charu and atte ka halwa or the Gurudwara Prashad or the Kada Prashad. That was the neivediyam that I prepared yesterday. ⁣
⁣
Bulgur Wheat Pongal - Wash 1 cup of bulgur wheat and 1/2 cup of moong dal and pressure cook it along with one slit green chili, 1.5 tsps salt and 4 cups of water. Release the pressure and mash it thoroughly. Then do the usual ghee tempering with mustard seeds, cumin seeds, whole pepper, cashews, and finely chopped ginger.⁣
⁣
Atte Ka Halwa: In a heavy-bottom pan, add 1/3 cup of ghee and 1/2 cup of atta. (I used the Sujata Brand) Mix it vigorously and ensure there aren't any lumps. Keep mixing until the atta turns golden brown. It will first become frothy, and then it will brown. It took me about 13~15 minutes over medium heat. Parellely, bring 1 cup of water to boil and add 1/2 cup of jaggery When the jaggery is all dissolved, add it to the atta and mix vigorously. Slowly it will thicken, and ghee will ooze. It took me 5 minutes for the ghee to ooze out on the side. That's it. Turn off the heat. Relish it.⁣

Как выбрать напольное покрытие для балкона и лоджии?🙈
⠀
В последние несколько лет все более популярным становится переоборудование балконов и лоджий под так называемые лаунж-зоны.
⠀
Таким образом на застекленной лоджии и балконе получается уютная зона отдыха, а утепленная лоджия превращается еще и в дополнительную комнату в квартире.
⠀
И даже на обычных открытых балконах многие стараются навести красоту, чтобы этот участок жилья не превращался в традиционный склад лыж, коробок и непонятно зачем нужных предметов.
Но какой материал оптимально подойдет для балконов и лоджий? 🤔
⠀
Чтобы выбрать напольное покрытие необходимо понимать застекленная у вас лоджия или нет.
⠀
Для застекленных лоджий часто рекомендуют кафельную плитку или керамогранит, но это не совсем правильно. Эти напольные покрытия устойчивы к перепадам температур. Но это, пожалуй, единственный ощутимый плюс использования керамических материалов. Плитка и керамогранит – покрытия скользкие, холодные и хрупкие. Так что комфорта они не добавят.
⠀
Кварц-винил тоже можно использовать на застекленных лоджиях. Он более устойчив к нагрузкам, так что смело ставьте в импровизированной лаунж-зоне кофейный столик или небольшое кресло – плитка не продавится и не треснет.
⠀
Для укладки на открытом балконе кварц-винил совершенно не подходит.
⠀
️Ведь это исключительно интерьерный материал. ❗❗❗
⠀
Балкон же – это, по сути, улица. Поэтому и укладывать здесь можно покрытие, которое соответствует условиям внешней среды, – кафельную плитку или керамогранит, террасную доску. Кстати, по той же причине кварц-винил недопустимо укладывать на открытых верандах или в беседках.
⠀
В итоге,
⠀
При обустройстве стильной лаунж-зоны наилучшим напольным покрытием для утепленных лоджий станет кварц-виниловая плитка Fine Floor.
⠀
Ее легко монтировать, и она обеспечит комфорт и красоту. Для застекленных неутепленных лоджий допускается клеевой кварц-винил, а также кафель или керамогранит. А вот для обычных балконов кварц-винил совсем не подходит, так как это равносильно тому, что вы уложите красивую интерьерную плитку прямо на улицу.

Nesse emirado, a maior preocupação são as construções das próximas obras de arte arquitetônicas, a quebra de novos recordes mundiais e a invenção de melhores entretenimentos.. Só não é absolutamente perfeito pq faltou inventarem um modo de refrigerar as áreas externas 🤣. “It’s impossible until it’s done.” When it feels like the days are sooo long and it only seems to get harder, sleepless nights with an infant (0 days old) and a barely toddler (12 months).
♥️Mama, this season is the hardest.

2 diapers, 2 crying babies, 2 sick babies, 2 breastfeeding babies, 2 babies wanting to be held.
♥️Mama, this season is the hardest.

Growing into toddlers and both are learning how to express themselves. Chasing 2 toddlers in two opposite directions. They want everything to do with you, they need you, they want you at all times. ♥️Mama, this season is the hardest.

Every season seems to be the “hardest” when you’re going through it, until you get through it. When I look back, I remember reminding myself often that this could be the “last time” they’ll want to nurse, be held, cuddled, and that helped me to cherish every moment with my babies.

I wish time would pause now!⏳ So mamas, this is just a reminder that you will get through it and you will miss it!

3/3 Soulcrate’s Final Show / Digital.
Canon 5D Mk4, Canon 35mm 1.4L & 24-70 2.8L.
.
Story time:
The first way I describe Soulcrate Music to people outside of my home state of South Dakota is a homegrown rap group that raps about just that, what they truly are and where they’re actually from. After assuring them my hometown Sioux Falls is actually a city, and that creative things do come out of it, I double up on how impressive the group is, and how lucky anyone around our city is, or was, to have a group like Soulcrate sharing and electrifying the creative space.
.
I was first introduced to their music around 2007 by @awaxakins, and hated it. Hehe. Over the following year my mind opened up more to hip-hop style rap influence, and upon giving Soulcrate another chance, I fell in love with them. Ten years later, and five after leaving Sioux Falls, little had changed in my love for the group and frequency of rotation in my ears.
.
Thus when their final show was announced, I felt like nothing should stop me from coming home to attend. Unfortunately it landed on the weekend of Monterey Car Week’s heartiest days, days in which the most bespoke of bespoke vehicles would be lining the streets and lapping the racetrack of the Northern California city. What a bummer, I’d have to miss it. Monterey that is.
.
Once linked up with old friends we hit the outdoor venue and documentation ensued. Film photos clicked first and carried through the entirety of the concert. Though as I’m always a little spooked with the assurance of film, I decided to make sure I got something I could rely on with digital, using a Canon 5D Mk4. I ended up with two rolls of 120mm film, three 35mm, and 900 digital photos.
.
In the end, that 48hrs home and two nights of missed sleep couldn’t have been more worth it. The show was amazing, emotion was heavy in the air, and I got to make images to remember it by. This is the kind of shit I love about photography; The stories, the background and the emotion so built up and then seemingly gone, but captured in a frame forever.
.
Thank you Wes, Dan, and Corey (and always ft. Isaac). I love you guys. #SoulcrateSucka

“Everyone has a prenup, most people just don’t know what it is,” my lawyer told me. He means the laws of your state are the default prenup.
▫️
A prenup does not mean you love or trust your partner less. It means you acknowledge that marriage is a huge financial decision and also a contract. You’d enter no other contract without protection.
▫️
The other cliche is to say you don’t hope for a car accident when you get auto insurance, but you want to be protected in case something happens. Same with a prenup. You aren’t hoping for divorce, but you acknowledge the possibility and are putting insurance measures in place.
▫️
A prenup also forces you to have serious money conversations and confront potential issues in your marriage. Money is a leading cause for divorce, so it’s far better to have these serious conversations before marriage! It doesn’t mean you will never fight about money in marriage, but it does help you confront potential problems before even saying I do.

M O T I V A T I O N ✨✨✨ Hay algo de lo que se habla poco o no se habla casi nada de la cara oscura de la expatriación: lo duro que es auto-motivarse 😱
.
Muchas personas me escriben para decirme lo mucho que les motivan mis vídeos en YouTube para no rendirse y aprender este élfico alemán y algunas también lo mucho que se motivan aquí en instagram por las mañanas con mis “¡Buenos días desde Mantequillalandia!” ☺️
.
Pues para mí son como terapia. Ambos. Es obvio, y no sería humana si no fuera así, que yo no estoy todos los días motivada. Pero “surrealistamente” en los días de falta de motivación me coge por hacer huelga a la japonesa: trabajar en más contenido para hacer crecer mi proyecto de crónicas germánicas. Es una de mis grandes pasiones desde que cambié mi vida por completo al tomar la decisión de venir a vivir a Alemania. Y, aunque sólo fuera una sola persona la que se motivara con mis vídeos y mis historias, todo ese esfuerzo merece la pena 🥰
.
Comunicar es algo que me apasiona. Y que esa comunicación fomente el diálogo y el aprendizaje por ambas partes. Que compartáis vuestro punto de vista me ayuda a aprender. Lo de enrollarme menos ya es más difícil porque “lo practico desde pequeña” 😅😂😂 pero os prometo que lo intento y en lo de ir al grano he mejorado mucho 🤣🤣🤣
.
Hay días de soledad que son más difíciles y estos días lo han sido. Aunque no lo parezca he tenido que afrontar varios días sola y admiro mucho a quienes afrontan sola o solo muchos días 🙌🏻
.
Quería compartir hoy esta reflexión con vosotros mientras miro si la motivación llega por la derecha ahí a lo lejos 😅 Eso sí, hoy ya sin gorro 😌 pero era a mediodía 😆
.
¡Feliz noche queridos germánicas y germánicos! ❤️😘

N E W  P O S T ✨✨✨ El año pasado sufrí la peor experiencia de mi vida como blogger: un hacker se apoderó de mi blog. No pude ni entrar durante una semana entera. Mi conexión no era lo suficientemente segura 💥
🔹
Cuando pasó todo, después de mucho trabajo y ayuda de profesionales, lo recuperé. Y escribí un post y grabé un vídeo con la experiencia y con todo lo que hice y cuánto me ayudó mi querido equipo de @webempresa
🔹
Esta vez os traigo otra novedad que nos sirve a todos, tengamos blog o no, puesto que protege la amenaza más importante de internet: nuestra conexión.
🔹
¿Os imagináis salir a la calle con las manos abiertas y alzadas y en cada una de ellas tener nuestro móvil, nuestro monedero y, aún peor, nuestra libreta prohibida de contraseñas? Los carteristas nos harían la ola 🙌🏻 y nos darían hasta las gracias por facilitarles el trabajo 🥳 PUES ASÍ SALIMOS A LA “CALLE VIRTUAL” 😱 la mayoría de nosotros cada día en cuanto nos conectamos a internet desde nuestros dispositivos!!! Tablets, móviles, ordenadores,... Y no únicamente el Hardware, también toda la información que guardamos y compartimos está igual de desprotegida.
🔹
Por eso os traigo para todos este nuevo post, donde os cuento cómo estar bien protegidos en internet. Nuestra información, nuestros dispositivos y nuestras contraseñas 🌟🔒🌟 La cara de la Foto la entenderéis al leer el nuevo post en el blog ☺️

This year has been a year of #forgiveness- a #journey. I have forgiven those who who are deeply committed to misunderstanding me and invalidating my experiences, because it threatens their ability to confront their own misgivings. To #forgive is to do so without resentment. I have learned to see people’s need to manipulate and control others from a lense that is more forgiving, less harsh- still working on it. I have learned to forgive myself- embrace my own uniqueness and grant myself the ability to make mistakes, learn and therefore grow. I grant this to others as well. I have learned that you can’t hold people who have no #standards accountable and you have to forgive yourself for placing expectations on people, especially those without values. I have learned To be #humbled by my blessings. To survive what I have been through and still #thrive and choose to be grateful for the life that I have chosen. I have detached myself from harmful and negative relatives who unconsciously exploit their relationship to me as a means to avoid their own secret inner turmoil and deflect their own emotional conflicts and disturbances. I instead have a greater appreciation for the people in my life who DO support me- with their encouragement, kindness, warmth and love and I am in #gratitude for what they reveal to me in #spirit everyday. 💋

Mě vždycky baví koukat na takový ty fotky před a po a tak jsem hledala v mobilu, jestli mám nějakou fotku z června, kdy jsem měla o 10 kilo víc. No, z dobrýho důvodu jsem se tenkrát nefotila a mám jen jednu, strašnou z kabinky v obchodě. A tak jsem se v podobně strašný póze vyfotila i dneska pro porovnání 😂 (posuňte úvodní fotku doprava)...vím, nemám žádnou fitnes formu a ještě to chce něco sundat a zpevnit se, ale pro mě je to strašnej úspěch. Já svoje tělo nikdy neměla moc ráda a ať jsem byla tlustá nebo hubená, vždycky jsem se viděla jen tlustě a nevábně. Po těhotenství a porodu jsem si svýho těla začala víc vážit, protože jsem viděla, co ve skutečnosti dokáže, že není tak k ničemu, jak mi vždycky přišlo. No a pak jsem se pořád omlouvala, že mám kila navíc, protože jsem “před necelým rokem” porodila, že mám sníženou funkci štítný žlázy, že mám málo času, ale to jsem sama sobě dost kecala. Byly to dortíčky a další cukry, proč jsem brečela, když jsem si byla kupovat ty plavky (nakonec jsem si je nekoupila). Vlastně jsem nezačala hubnout cíleně, přišly nějaký stresy a já v takový situaci nemám chuť jíst a pak mi došlo, jak strašně se stravuju a vůbec o sebe nepečuju... a pustila jsem se do toho, abych s tím něco udělala. A teď je mi tak dobře! Nemám nervy, když si musím jít koupit kalhoty, nebojím se sundat triko, fyzicky je mi líp. A konečně se mám ráda. Mám ráda svoje hustý vlasy, modrý oči, líbí se mi moje tetování a teď už mám ráda i svojí postavu. Když se člověk přijme, najednou totiž nevidí vepředu ty negativa, který má, ale pracuje s tím, co je na něm dobrýho. A každej máme na sobě něco dobrýho. Tak pokud jste vy teď ve stadiu, že se nemáte rádi, tak do toho jďete. Udělejte cokoliv pro to, abyste se to naučili, protože to přináší obrovskou úlevu ❤️ Tak a já to jdu sdílet, než se za tenhle příspěvek začnu stydět a rozmyslim si ho 😂

TATCHA Silk Canvas ($52) Review
.
Okay guys, let’s talk about this Tatcha primer. It’s very expensive so I went in with high expectations!
.
The consistency of the primer is kind of hard to describe... it’s not super “siliconey” like the porefessional but it’s also not liquidy... it’s creamy and you’re supposed to warm it up btwn your fingers and apply.
.
It does smooth out the skin and is semi mattifying but also very hydrating. However, it doesn’t fill my pores well ... which is my #1 concern.
.
The primer is good... but not amazing for its $52 price tag. I have other primers that do the same job for less... but at the same time, I like it.
.
It DOES make my makeup last allllll day.. THAT, I would say, is its BEST quality. It blurs my face a slight bit, but I wish it filled my pores. I definitely want to try more from this brand!
.
It’s worth trying because I really do like it a lot despite the high price ... and we can’t deny that the packaging is AMAZING! ...😊😊
.
